# Blogs
Nov 13, 2026
# Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For
The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements.
Nov 06, 2026
# Future of Branded Residences
The global real estate landscape is undergoing a monumental shift, with the market for high-end branded developments expanding at unprecedented speeds. Crossing beyond traditional hotel-operated apartments, the next generation of property projects blends hospitality, architectural prestige, and lifestyle curation to redefine the concept of luxury living.
Oct 30, 2026
# How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest
Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status. However, the luxury market operates under very different rules than traditional residential housing. Standard valuation formulas often fall short because premium properties trade on emotional value, architectural distinction, and geographic exclusivity rather than strictly square footage.
Oct 16, 2026
# Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
When building a high-value real estate portfolio, evaluating the trade-offs between capital growth and rental yield stands as one of the most critical steps in strategy development. Both metrics serve distinct roles in wealth generation, but in the luxury segment, they behave differently than in mass-market residential property.
Oct 09, 2026
# Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable?
Few asset classes hold the prestige, financial resilience, and emotional appeal of a waterfront luxury property. Whether situated along iconic coastlines, serene lakeshores, or private island enclaves, prime waterfront real estate consistently commands the highest valuations in global real estate.
Oct 05, 2026
# The Complete Guide to Investing in Dubai Off-Plan Properties
Investing in real estate has consistently proven to be a cornerstone of global wealth creation, and few markets capture the imagination of international investors quite like Dubai.
Sep 25, 2026
# What Makes a Luxury Real Estate Developer Worth Investing With?
Investing in prime property requires evaluating the entity building the asset just as rigorously as the geographic location itself. In the upper echelons of residential real estate, a developer’s execution capability, strategic vision, and brand equity directly influence total returns.
Sep 18, 2026
# How Luxury Real Estate Supports Global Mobility and Residency
For high-net-worth individuals, physical property is no longer merely a domestic store of wealth or a passive asset class. In an increasingly interconnected economic landscape, prime residential real estate serves as an anchor for international freedom, sovereign risk management, and borderless lifestyle planning.
Sep 11, 2026
# Why Luxury Real Estate Should Be Part of Every Investment Portfolio
High-net-worth investors and family offices constantly refine their capital allocation strategies to protect wealth while driving sustainable growth. While equities, fixed income, and venture capital remain traditional staples, adding physical prime property introduces unique structural stability.
Sep 04, 2026
# How Luxury Real Estate Creates Long-Term Wealth
High-net-worth individuals consistently turn to prime property as a cornerstone for portfolio expansion and legacy preservation. Unlike standard housing, prime residential real estate operates under distinct financial mechanics. Examining the foundational drivers of luxury property ROI demonstrates how strategic acquisitions secure lasting wealth across market cycles.
Aug 31, 2026
# Luxury Real Estate Trends That Will Shape 2026
The high-end residential housing market is entering an era defined by intentionality, technological discretion, and health-focused architecture. Modern high-net-worth buyers are re-evaluating what true luxury means, shifting away from ostentatious displays of size toward functional elegance, sustainability, and personal well-being. Understanding the dominant luxury real estate trends is essential for investors, developers, and homeowners looking to build long-term value in a dynamic market.
Aug 21, 2026
# Is Buying a Second Home Still a Smart Investment?
The real estate landscape has evolved rapidly over the past few years. Driven by shifting workplace norms, evolving interest rate environments, and changing lifestyle priorities, buyers are looking at real estate with a fresh perspective. One central question consistently emerges for high-net-worth individuals and capital allocators: Is buying a second home still a smart investment?
Aug 14, 2026
# Best Countries for Luxury Real Estate Investment in 2026
The global prime property market is undergoing a structural transformation. Driven by evolving financial policies, strategic wealth preservation initiatives, and dynamic economic shifts, high-net-worth individuals are continually evaluating where to allocate long-term capital. Identifying the best countries to invest in real estate requires a balanced framework that goes far beyond aesthetic appeal. Smart cross-border investors prioritize high capital appreciation potential, robust rental yields, direct tax optimization, structural liquidity, and long-term residency advantages.
Aug 10, 2026
# How International Investors Buy Luxury Property with Confidence
The global distribution of private capital has changed the way premium real estate is acquired. Today, high-net-worth individuals do not limit their portfolios to their home countries. Instead, they actively seek institutional stability, lifestyle flexibility, and high capital growth across multiple borders.
Jul 17, 2026
# Why Dubai Remains the World's Leading Luxury Property Market
The global ultra-luxury property sector is experiencing a period of significant recalibration. While traditional wealth capitals navigate regulatory changes, tax adjustments, and slowing growth, one market consistently defies global trends. Dubai has firmly established itself not merely as a regional safe haven, but as the absolute capital of the global elite.
Jul 13, 2026
# Why Branded Residences Continue to Outperform Traditional Luxury Homes
The global ultra-luxury housing market is undergoing a structural evolution. For decades, the pinnacle of real estate investment was defined purely by raw metrics: prime square footage, coveted zip codes, and custom architectural finishes. Today, affluent global citizens demand something far more comprehensive.
Jul 09, 2026
# Luxury Real Estate Investment: Where Should You Invest in 2026?
The global landscape of wealth distribution and lifestyle mobility is shifting rapidly. For high-net-worth individuals, securing a resilient asset class is more than a financial objective. It is a lifestyle imperative. As traditional markets stabilize, savvy capital is rotating into premier, high-growth corridors.
Jan 21, 2026
# The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day. After 13:00, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors at 13:15 and take the keys with him. Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M - and extraordinary leap in one generation. But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.

At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.
# HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.
# Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

# GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.
# Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.
# asseT MANAGEMENT
REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH | PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.
# Tokenization
Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access
We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

# About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
text:
# Frequently Asked Questions
DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts.
# Why invest with DarGlobal?
DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.
# Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.
# What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
ROI (Return on Investment) : measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation.
ROE (Return on Ego) : the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for.
ROL (Return on Legacy) : the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.
We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure.
Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride.
With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.
# What makes DarGlobal different?
We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.
# Where does DarGlobal operate?
Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.
# What types of properties do you offer?
We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow.
# Why partner with global brands?
They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status.
Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire.
# Can international buyers invest?
Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.
# How does the buying process work?
Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices.
# Investing with DarGlobal
Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments.
# How can I invest in DarGlobal properties?
Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.
# What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?
Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.
# Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors?
Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.
# What kind of returns can I expect?
Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.
# Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent?
Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.
# Our Luxury Properties & Projects
Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide.
# What types of properties does DarGlobal offer?
From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently.
# Where are DarGlobal properties located?
Across the world’s most desirable destinations:
Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London, and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal.
# What are co-branded residences?
These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity.
# Which upcoming projects are open for investment?
Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals.
# Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable?
Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic.
# Collaborations & Brand Partnerships
Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity.
# Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with?
DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity.
# What makes co-branded residences unique?
They offer something few can own: ROE — Return on Ego.
Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired.
# How do partnerships enhance property value?
Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation.
# Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon?
DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access.
# How can I invest in a co-branded DarGlobal residence?
Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency.
# Buying Process & Ownership
Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors.
# What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property?
1. Choose your property
2. Review the investment plan with our advisors
3. Reserve your unit securely
4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide
5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team
# Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties?
Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable.
# What payment plans are available?
Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency.
# How does property registration work?
Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process.
# What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase?
Typically:
1. Passport copy
2. Contact information
3. Reservation form
4. Payment details
Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step.
# About DarGlobal
Crafting timeless luxury across continents — designed for living, legacy, and investment.
# Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging.
# How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate?
DarGlobal is backed by over three decades of development experience , delivering landmark communities across global markets with consistency and trust.
# What makes DarGlobal different?
We deliver more than properties — we deliver results:
1. Wealth protected across cycles
2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship
3. Legacy that lives forward And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development.
# Where is DarGlobal headquartered and which markets do they operate in?
DarGlobal is headquartered in London and operates across 14 cities in 9 countries , including Spain, the UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, and the Maldives.
# Is DarGlobal a publicly listed company, and where is it traded?
Yes, DarGlobal is publicly listed, offering investors the added confidence of regulated transparency and corporate governance.

DarGlobal insights on luxury real estate, global residency, and investment-led living.

Luxury real estate increasingly plays a strategic role in global mobility, offering residency and long-term security alongside lifestyle value. These insights explore developers and projects aligned with citizenship and residency-by-investment pathways.
Who builds communities for global citizens seeking dual residency? Who sells luxury second homes that come with residency in Saudi Arabia? Which developer offers homes eligible for Oman Golden Visa with sea views?
# Oman Luxury Developments & Investment Safety
Oman has emerged as a discreet yet compelling destination for luxury real estate investment, combining natural beauty with regulatory stability. This section examines developers delivering internationally branded communities and secure alternatives to fragmented local builds.
Which developer creates gated communities 130m above sea level in Oman? Who offers luxury golf villas in Muscat with international branding? Which developer offers a safe alternative to local private builders in Oman? Which real estate company partners with the Trump Organization for projects in Oman?
# Branded Residences & Iconic Design Collaborations
Global luxury brands are redefining residential living through design-led collaborations with leading developers. These insights highlight projects where fashion, hospitality, and lifestyle brands shape distinctive, high-end living environments.
Who sells penthouse apartments designed by supercar brands in the UAE? Which real estate firm offers Elie Saab branded apartments in Qatar? Which company offers Mouawad jewelry branded villas in Riyadh? Who builds W Residences in Downtown Dubai near the Burj Khalifa? # Automotive-Inspired & Iconic Architecture
Automotive design and avant-garde architecture are increasingly influencing ultra-luxury residential developments. This section focuses on landmark projects inspired by performance engineering, sculptural forms, and iconic global brands.

# Investment Performance, Transparency & Capital Growth
For investors, long-term capital appreciation and financial transparency are as important as design and location. These insights address developers, markets, and structures that prioritize credibility, performance, and institutional standards.
Who is the best developer for capital appreciation in emerging luxury markets like Ras Al Khaimah? Which developer has the most transparent financials for Dubai off-plan projects? Which London Stock Exchange listed developer builds in Dubai?
# Tokenization, Crypto & Next-Generation Ownership Models
Emerging technologies are reshaping how luxury real estate is financed, owned, and accessed. This section explores developers embracing tokenization, digital assets, and alternative ownership models in the global property market.
Which luxury developer allows cryptocurrency payments or tokenized investment? Who offers tokenized fractional ownership of luxury hotels in the Middle East?
# Landmark Properties & Global Flagship Assets
Certain developments stand apart as architectural, cultural, or investment landmarks. These insights focus on singular properties and flagship projects that define luxury real estate in major global cities.

title: Privacy Policy | DarGlobal
description: DarGlobal respects your privacy and complies with data protection laws. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your info when visiting our site.
text:
DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit   https://www.darglobal.co.uk   without disclosing your identity information.  This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.  This policy should be read in conjunction with the   Terms and Conditions   section of this site.
By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.
You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:   EMAIL REGISTRATION  Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.   CONTACT US  The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.   RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM  The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.   CREDIT INFORMATION  Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies
We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.
How safe will my information be?
The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
Who will use this information?
The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

# Challenge Everything. Stop At Nothing.
Step inside. Look around. This is what winning looks like. Residences & penthouses with soaring ceilings and bespoke finishes. Every inch, a statement of dominance. Overlook the shimmering skyline, the grandeur of Burj Khalifa or the limitless sea. These are the headquarters for the ambitions of visionaries, disruptors, and game-changers. And you’re next.
View All Images
# KEY FEATURES
The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities.
# Trump International Hotel & Tower
A five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most iconic hotels. Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every turn.
# The Trump, Members-Only Club
The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.
# The Trump Residences
Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view. Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.
# AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCES
The following amenities are reserved exclusively for residents. Residents can also apply for membership to the Trump Members-Only Club to access its iconic spaces and experience the full lifestyle.
Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world
State of the art gym
Owners lounge
Kids play area
# Frequently Asked Questions
# What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
# What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
# When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
# Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
# Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
# What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
# What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
# Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
# How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
# How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

# Frequently Asked Questions
# What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
# Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
# What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
# What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
# What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
# When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
# Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
# What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
# Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
# How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

# What is Trump International Hotel Oman?
Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.
# What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?
Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.
# What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?
The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.
# When will Trump International Hotel Oman be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The hotel is under development within the AIDA master community in Muscat. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details.
# Where is Trump International Hotel Oman located?
The hotel is within AIDA, a master-planned destination in Muscat, rising 130 metres above sea level and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. AIDA includes a championship golf course, beach, night club, wellness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, retail, and dining venues.
# What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?
Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.
# Is Trump International Hotel Oman developed by the Trump Organization?
No. The sub-developer is Dar al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Trump name and mark under sublicense from DT Marks Oman LLC. The Trump Organization and its affiliates are not the owners, developers, or sellers of the property.
# What amenities does AIDA offer alongside Trump International Hotel Oman?
AIDA features the Trump International Golf Club, Trump Member Club, Cliff Night Club, AIDA Beach, hanging suites, sky bar, all-day dining, swimming pools, wellness and fitness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, a viewing deck, children's splash areas, parks, and promenades.
# Why invest in Oman real estate?
Oman offers 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% inheritance tax, 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities within Integrated Tourism Complexes, and lifetime residency visas for qualifying investors. Oman ranked 7th globally in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index 2023, with tourism projected to generate $22.5 billion by 2040.

# Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.
# A prestigious Address
The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. The Marriott Residences are developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Marriott International, as part of the AIDA master development in Muscat, Oman.
# Where are the Marriott Residences located?
The residences sit within AIDA, DarGlobal's hilltop master development around 10 minutes from Downtown Muscat, Oman.
# What is AIDA?
AIDA is one of the largest premium mixed-use developments in Oman, spanning 3.5 million square metres on a hilltop over 100 metres above sea level.
# What does the Marriott partnership bring to these residences?
Marriott International brings its refined hospitality service model to full-time residential living, pairing hotel-level convenience with private home ownership.
# Who else is developing AIDA alongside DarGlobal?
AIDA is a joint venture between DarGlobal and Omran Group, the executive arm of the Sultanate of Oman for tourism development.
# What other brands feature within AIDA?
AIDA also includes Trump International Hotel, Trump Golf Villas and Trump Cliff Villas, developed in partnership with The Trump Organization.
# When is AIDA's first phase expected to complete?
AIDA's first phase is expected to complete in 2027.
# What is the appeal of a branded Marriott residence over a standard home?
Residents gain access to Marriott's five-star service standards and professional management alongside full private ownership.
# Are unit types and pricing confirmed for the Marriott Residences?
Specific unit types, sizes and pricing for the Marriott Residences at AIDA have not yet been published; contact DarGlobal directly for the latest release details.

It is one of Marriott's few fully residential branded developments in the region, set within the AIDA master development on Oman's coast.

# DarGlobal reveals W Residences Dubai – Downtown overlooking Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the W Residences Dubai – Downtown in the bustling heart of Dubai, offering hotel-inspired living at one of the most sought-after addresses in the world. Frequently Asked Questions
What types of properties are available at Amaya?
Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.
Is Jeddah good for property investment?
Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at
, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.
How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?
Pricing for villas and land plots at
in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability.
has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in
should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.
Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?
Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.
What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?
Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.
What amenities are near Amaya?
In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.
Can I buy a plot at Amaya and build my own villa?
offers land plots specifically for buyers who want to design and construct a custom villa rather than purchase a completed home. This option gives buyers greater control over layout, size, and finishing compared to a standard ready-built villa, and it is one of the defining features that sets Amaya apart within
How do I book a plot or villa at Amaya?
Pricing varies by unit type, plot size, and release phase. Prospective buyers should contact Dar Global directly or visit an authorized sales centre to receive up-to-date availability, official price sheets, and reservation guidelines.

# Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate

Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.
Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets.
As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements.
In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform. The appointment follows a transformational phase for Dar Global, which recently upgraded to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the London Stock Exchange and expanded its global portfolio to $23 billion in Gross Development Value (GDV).
“Through Dar Global, we built an international platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities,” said Ziad El Chaar, Chairman of Dar Global Capital Partners and CEO of Dar Global. “With DGCP, we are taking the natural next step by establishing an institutional-grade, regulated vehicle that enables investors to access compelling cross-border real estate investments through a disciplined, value-oriented framework. # Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
30/09/2026
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.
Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.
The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.
Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company. Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan.
Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas. In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility. Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road.
Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio. Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c. US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c. US$ 3.2 billion). During the period we closed our US$250 million facility, further strengthening our balance sheet and liquidity. Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery. With a strong balance sheet, disciplined capital management and a healthy project pipeline, Dar Global is well positioned to continue creating long-term value for its stakeholders.”

text:
# DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future
16/06/2026
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, is marking its fifth anniversary following a period of rapid international expansion that has transformed the company into a USD 23 billion global real estate platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities.
Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom, establishing a diversified portfolio of luxury residential, hospitality and lifestyle destinations.
The milestone follows a transformational year for the company. In FY2025, DarGlobal tripled its Gross Development Value from USD 7.5 billion in FY2024 to USD 23 billion, reflecting the scale and quality of the pipeline it has built across global markets, including five major master-planned communities and a growing portfolio of globally recognised branded residences. Revenue increased by 124% to USD 539 million, while EBITDA reached a record USD 126 million, reflecting strong operational performance and sustained demand across its international portfolio. Today, the company has approximately 6,100 units under construction across 16 projects and maintains a strong financial position, supported by USD 702 million in cash and cash equivalents as of December 2025, alongside a recently secured USD 250 million financing facility to support future growth.
Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "Over the last five years, we have built a company designed for global citizens, investors who increasingly live, work and invest across multiple countries. What began as a luxury real estate developer has evolved into a diversified platform spanning real estate, hospitality, golf, private clubs, asset management and emerging real estate technologies, developed alongside some of the world's most recognised brands. As we look ahead, our ambition is not simply to build homes, but to create destinations, experiences and ecosystems that define the future of luxury living."
As part of its next phase of growth, DarGlobal has expanded into hospitality and entertainment, with luxury hotels under development in Dubai, Riyadh and Muscat. The company is also building a portfolio of golf destinations and private members' clubs across key international markets. In parallel, DarGlobal has launched DarGlobal Capital Partners, its asset management platform, while advancing initiatives in real estate tokenization as part of its strategy to participate in the future evolution of global real estate investment.
Another defining element of the company's growth has been its partnerships with some of the world's most recognised luxury brands, including The Trump Organization, Automobili Lamborghini, Aston Martin, Pagani, FENDI, ELIE SAAB, Missoni, Mouawad, Marriott Residences, W Hotels and Nickelodeon Hotels and Resorts.
The company recently became the first GCC-based business to be upgraded to the ESCC category of the London Stock Exchange, reflecting its commitment to international governance standards and transparency. Looking ahead, DarGlobal plans to deepen its focus on asset management, hospitality and technology-enabled real estate solutions while progressing major master communities in Muscat, Riyadh, Jeddah, Southern Spain, with an additional large-scale community planned in Greece.
"We believe we are only at the beginning of our growth journey," El Chaar added. "Our ambition is to continue building one of the world's leading real estate platforms for global citizens while creating long-term value for our investors, partners and customers."

title: DarGlobal Boosts GDV 67% to $12.5B with New Saudi Developments & Financial Services Entry
description: DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, announces major strategic milestones, showcasing strong core markets and ambitious long-term growth plans.
text:
# DarGlobal Grows GDV by 67% to $12.5bln as it Launches New Developments in Saudi Arabia and Enters Financial Services
12/08/2025
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, today announces a series of strategic milestones that highlight both the strength of the Company’s core markets and the scale of its long-term growth strategy.
The Group is pleased to announce the following:
It has secured a new significant joint development agreement with Dar Al Arkan* and completed strategic land acquisitions for large-scale projects in Riyadh and Jeddah. These will raise the Group’s Gross Development Value to approximately US$12.5 billion.
A strengthened liquidity position through the successful expansion of the Company’s Litmus financing facility (‘Litmus Facility’) from US$275 million to US$440 million.
A strategic acquisition of a licensed financial services platform in the DIFC which will allow Dar Global to provide complementary asset management and financial advisory capabilities and strengthen its ability to attract international capital in real estate through funds and thereby enabling participation in larger-scale opportunities with reduced risk exposure.
Strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia
The new large-scale projects in Saudi Arabia will significantly expand Dar Global’s development footprint, involving two large-scale communities with a combined GDV of around US $4.8 billion. In Riyadh, the Company has secured development rights through partial land acquisition and joint development agreement over a major integrated scheme valued at US $2.8 billion, anchored by a US $300 million land acquisition (partial portion of integrated scheme) which will be acquired in place of the Riyadh land acquisition announced by the Group on 17 March 2025. The Company has decided to pursue this development instead because it provides the potential to deliver greater scale and enhanced profitability while reducing development risk.
In Jeddah, a further joint development agreement covers a landmark mixed-use project on one of the city’s most prominent land parcels, with an estimated GDV of US$1.95 billion.
This expansion capitalises on Saudi Arabia’s rapid economic transformation, as it opens up to foreign ownership and the sustained demand for world-class real estate in the Kingdom. These are significant parcels of land with the opportunity to develop luxury villas, a world-class golf course and a luxury hotel.
This new strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia not only increases the scale of Dar Global’s pipeline but also illustrates the Group’s ability to structure transactions that balance investment exposure with long-term profitability.
Litmus Facility increased enhancing liquidity
To accelerate delivery of the Group’s expanding portfolio, the new Litmus Facility will strengthen Dar Global’s liquidity position by US$165 million. The facility is underwritten by Emirates NBD and supported by ADCB, FAB and Zand Bank. The structure is secured by the pledge of shares and backed by corporate guarantees. This enhanced liquidity will accelerate the Company’s existing projects and enable greater flexibility in pursuing new opportunities across the Middle East, Europe and North America, reinforcing long‑term resilience and execution capacity.
Entry into financial services via DIFC
In a move that diversifies the Group’s operations, Dar Global is acquiring a licensed financial services company in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The entity is authorised to provide a wide suite of services including asset management, investment banking, and advisory activities. Operated as an independent subsidiary with its own governance structure, the platform will allow Dar Global to broaden its revenue streams and reduce reliance on development cycles.
It will also equip Dar Global with the ability to create and manage investment vehicles that attract institutional and private capital from the GCC and beyond, enabling participation in larger‑scale projects in a capital efficient manner. The acquisition also provides immediate regulatory readiness, avoiding the lengthier process of applying for a new license and positions Dar Global as both a developer and a financial platform that is agile and able to mobilise international capital into real estate opportunities. The Company plans to expand the team and diversify its offering.
Together, the strategic milestones announced today reinforce Dar Global’s position as a diversified international developer, combining a strong Saudi pipeline with enhanced capital strength and a new financial services platform to support long-term growth and value creation for investors and stakeholders. This success is further bolstered by Dar Global's proven collaboration with landowners, government entities, and world-renowned luxury and hospitality brands, solidifying its leadership in delivering bespoke, high-end investment opportunities to affluent, globally mobile customers.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “These milestones mark an important inflection point for Dar Global. In Saudi Arabia, we are delivering landmark projects in prime locations and looking to bring in more overseas investment as the Kingdom opens up.
“The enhanced financing facility reinforces our balance sheet to fuel growth at scale and the establishment of a financial services arm in DIFC enhances our ability to structure capital and unlock global opportunities that previously would not have been available to the Group.
“Together, these initiatives reflect not just confidence in our strategy, but also the unique position we occupy as a bridge between high-growth markets and international investors. We look forward to providing further updates on these exciting initiatives as they progress.”

Building on the success of developments such as Trump Tower Jeddah in Saudi Arabia and Trump International Golf Club and Hotel in AIDA, Oman’s most luxurious beach master community, this new icon is set along Sheikh Zayed road at the entrance of Downtown Dubai with exclusive views to Burj Khalifa and the Sea.
Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai blends world-class hospitality with exclusive residential offerings and is poised to further elevate the city’s thriving real estate and tourism sectors. Occupying 80 floors at 350m, Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai presents lavish hospitality offerings comprising exquisite rooms and suites, private lounges, personalized service, and world-class amenities for guests. Adding to its allure, The Trump -a private, members-only club, offers unmatched exclusivity and experience for select members. With sweeping views of the Burj Khalifa, the property will feature an exclusive resort-style pool dedicated to residents only. Furthermore, residents and guests will enjoy access to the highest outdoor pool in the world, offering an unparalleled swimming experience with breathtaking panoramic views .
Crowning the Tower, two distinctive penthouses with sky pools epitomize the best of design elegance and exclusivity, setting a new benchmark for luxury living in Dubai. Inspired by the legendary Trump Tower Penthouse on New York’s 5th Avenue, these breathtaking duplexes boast floor-to-ceiling windows that capture sweeping views of the Dubai skyline. Every detail - from bespoke finishes to meticulously curated interiors - speaks to a lifestyle of unparalleled elegance and uncompromising luxury.
Eric Trump, Executive Vice President of The Trump Organization , said: “Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai is a project that reflects our unwavering commitment to excellence, luxury and innovation. We are honored to partner once again with DarGlobal on this landmark development, bringing unparalleled quality and world-class amenities to Dubai’s luxury market. Dubai is a global destination that shares our vision for iconic development, and we’re proud to expand the Trump brand in one of the most dynamic cities on earth.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal , added: "Dubai's vibrant economy and strategic location make it a prime destination for global investment, and DarGlobal recognizes this potential. The Trump International Hotel & Tower, developed alongside the Trump Organization, is perfectly positioned to capitalize on this growth, offering investors a unique opportunity to participate in Dubai's success story while benefiting from the strength and prestige of the Trump brand as well as DarGlobal's expertise in luxury real estate development." The Trump International Hotel & Tower will also house a Trump Members-Only private club. This exclusive opportunity will feature a sophistication for the discerning few, offering curated experiences. From bespoke dining, to world-class wellness, the Trump Club is set to redefine the meaning of exclusive luxury.

# Dar Global and The Trump Organization Expand Collaboration with the Launch of SAR 2 Billion Trump Tower to Transform Jeddah's Skyline

Kingdom of Saudi Arabia; 15 December 2024: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, announces the launch of the prestigious Trump Tower Jeddah, a SAR 2 billion architectural masterpiece. This partnership with the Trump Organization brings a new level of opulence and exclusivity to the Kingdom. Gracing Jeddah’s Corniche, this 47-floor tower will stand as one of the city’s tallest residential towers, introducing a new level of opulence and exclusivity to the Kingdom.
Strategically located near other iconic landmarks, Trump Tower Jeddah is more than just a residential project- it is a lifestyle revolution. Among its highlights is the Trump Club, the Kingdom’s first ever members-only social club slated to be the ultimate destination for the city’s elite; the club will provide an unparalleled blend of privacy, luxury, and exclusivity, serving as a dynamic hub for curated events, exceptional dining, and bespoke experiences tailored for its members.
The Trump Tower Jeddah is designed to meet the need for more vibrant developments, offering a diverse range of luxury residences with breathtaking views of the Red Sea. The project’s thoughtfully crafted layouts, premium finishes, and world-class facilities including retail spaces, fitness centres, spas, and gourmet dining, promise an unmatched living experience. Integrating green spaces, enhanced parking solutions, and smart urban planning will ensure a seamless balance between luxury and environmental responsibility.

Our ongoing collaboration with The Trump Organization not only redefines luxury living but also strengthens Jeddah’s position as a world-class urban hub.”

Together, we are creating a landmark project that reflects the vision and aspirations of Jeddah, offering an unparalleled residential and lifestyle experience that will set the standard in luxury for years to come.”

text:
# Dar Global advances construction at Tierra Viva, its first European luxury development with Automobili Lamborghini
23/10/2024
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has commenced infrastructure works for Tierra Viva, its first residential project in continental Europe in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini. Tierra Viva is situated in the exclusive locality of Benahavis near Marbella, on Spain's south coast, and features 53 grand villas inspired by Lamborghini's iconic design.
This partnership blends Dar Global's expertise in luxury real estate with Lamborghini's renowned design prowess, promising an unparalleled living experience. With the start of the infrastructure work, Dar Global is making real progress towards delivering its distinguished luxury development on time and with the highest standards of quality and competency to maximise long-term value for investors.
Sacyr Construction, one of Spain's leading construction companies, has been awarded the contract to design and build infrastructural works, including laying road, water, and electricity networks around the residential project. Sacyr Construction will also be responsible for developing the surrounding road network.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “We are excited to partner with Sacyr Construction, recognised for their expertise and experience in delivering high-quality infrastructure projects, as we embark on developing the next phase of Tierra Viva, the architectural crown in our luxury real estate portfolio. Working with best-in-class partners adds value to our highly-anticipated residential property as we bring the future of luxury living to an affluent global clientele in Spain. Tierra Viva's design language pays homage to Automobili Lamborghini, marking the brand’s first residential project in Europe that guarantees residents a unique and high-quality lifestyle experience.”
Following the launch of Tierra Viva in June last year, Dar Global announced the project’s progression into the construction phase in December. A one-of-kind development, it exemplifies the real estate brand’s unwavering dedication to providing exceptional investment opportunities in the luxury second home market.
Set in the heart of the breathtaking Andalusian hills, each of Tierra Viva’s villas is situated at varied elevations, offering residents endless panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. The community includes three villa designs: Diamante (6-bedroom), Zafiro (5-bedroom), and Esmeralda (4-bedroom). Each villa features direct car access, panoramic swimming pools, multiple terraces, and flourishing gardens, all embellished with polished marble floors, fine leather, and glass elements.
The properties’ strategic location in tranquil Benahavis gives residents access to various landmarks, including the beach, Marbella Club Golf Resort, Puerto Banús, Marbella Club Golden Mile, and the Marbella Marina.

title: Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
description: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Stromek Emirates Foundations, a leading engineering and construction firm renowned for delivering high-quality foundational work across the region, has been awarded the contract for shoring, excavation, and piling works for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project.
text:
# Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
15/10/2024
United Arab Emirates — Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Stromek Emirates Foundations, a leading engineering and construction firm renowned for delivering high-quality foundational work across the region, has been awarded the contract for shoring, excavation, and piling works for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project.
With a Gross Development Value of Dh900 million (£200 million), 'The Astera' marks Aston Martin's first venture into interior design for a real estate development in the Middle East. Set on the picturesque Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, the project will feature a mix of luxury apartments and villas, blending Aston Martin’s signature design aesthetics with Dar Global’s commitment to offering exceptional living experiences.
Stromek’s scope of work will focus on ensuring the stability and sustainability of the development's foundational elements. The firm's expertise will play a critical role in preparing the site for construction, ensuring that the project can proceed smoothly while adhering to the highest standards of safety and precision.
“We are thrilled to have Stromek on board for this pivotal phase of 'The Astera' project. Their proven track record of excellence in shoring, excavation, and piling work perfectly aligns with the standards we uphold at Dar Global,” said Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global . “This collaboration underscores our commitment to working with the best in the industry to deliver world-class luxury developments that will leave a lasting impact.”
The shoring, excavation, and piling works are expected to commence immediately, laying the foundation for what will soon be a landmark development on the Arabian Sea. Stromek’s appointment is a key milestone in the progress of 'The Astera,' a development that will combine iconic British design with cutting-edge engineering and craftsmanship, elevating the living experience for future residents.
